preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.showWelcome: Show the welcome dialog at startup
preferences.dropLeadingZero: Hide the leading zero on p-values
preferences.dropLeadingZeroHint: When on, values that cannot exceed 1 are written as ".024" (the APA/SPSS convention); when off, "0.024".
preferences.consoleEnabledHint: When off, the R console mode in the Syntax/Terminal tab can't be started. SPSS Syntax mode and menu-driven analyses are unaffected.
preferences.categoricalMaxDistinctHint: An all-integer column with fewer distinct values than this is imported as Nominal instead of Scale. 0 = old behavior (everything Scale).
preferences.detectDecimalCommaHint: When off, only dot-decimal notation is recognized; comma-decimal columns import as text.
preferences.readStatLabels: Read SPSS/Stata variable and value labels (.sav/.dta)
preferences.readStatLabelsHint: When on, the file is read once more during import (via R's foreign package).
preferences.updateDontShowAgain: Don't show again for this version
preferences.updateDontShowAgainHint: When checked, the StatusBar notification for this version is hidden; it reappears once a newer version is released.
preferences.updateAutoCheckHint: When off, SAI Statistics sends no version request at startup and the status bar shows no update notice. The change applies from the next start.
preferences.updateManagedByFlathub: This installation is updated through Flathub. New versions arrive through your software center or "flatpak update".

setup.title: Setup Required
setup.rNotFound: R was not found. Analyses run by calling R — without it installed, no analysis can produce a result.
setup.rNotFoundHint: After installing R, click "Check Again". Data View, Variable View, and the SPSS Syntax editor still work without R.

setup.packagesHint: Installing downloads from CRAN — an internet connection is required.
